storyCards.headline: Megamix '04: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Janet Jackson's "Megamix '04" — original release 2004. "Janet Megamix 04" is a megamix produced by DJ Chris Cox, released on December 11, 2003, to promote Jackson's February 2004 Super Bowl halftime show.

Artist: Janet Jackson · Title: Megamix '04 · Album: Janet - Janet Megamix 04 · Year: 2003 · Genre: Contemporary R&B · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/2000's/Janet Jackson - Megamix '04.mp4.

Song information
The Chris Cox-produced megamix contains thirteen of Jackson's past singles, and was released prior to the lead single from 2004's Damita Jo, "Just a Little While".

During the production of the remix, Cox's studio in California was ravaged by a wildfire, and the DJ had to evacuate it midway through the project.
